children: Azio AI Holdings entered a financing arrangement with YA II PN that provides up to $50 million in equity funding under a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement. The company also received a $3.5 million pre-paid advance via convertible notes, including a $3.0 million first tranche funded on Sep 25, 2026, with a 4% original issue discount and 6% interest, and a $0.5 million second tranche contingent on effectiveness of a resale registration. Pricing for draws is based on VWAP with 3%–4% discounts, and issuance is constrained by Nasdaq’s 19.99% Exchange Cap and a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. As consideration, YA II PN received warrants for 1,735,758 shares at $0.01. A related Registration Rights Agreement will register up to 28,000,000 shares for resale.
Agreement 1: Azio AI Holdings Secures $50 Million Standby Equity Facility With YA II PN, Draws $3.0 Million
: Standby equity purchase agreement with pre-paid advance and convertible notes
: SEPA through Sep 25 2029; notes mature Sep 25 2027
Agreement 2: Azio AI Holdings Signs Registration Rights Agreement to Register Up to 28 Million Shares
: Registration rights agreement for resale of financing shares
: Facilitate resale of shares issued under financing
